Iron directive
Command and control

Factories of flame
Numbers replace us
No one has a name

Voice turns to code
March to the rhythm
Of the overload

[Chorus]
Iron directive
Command and control
Iron directive
Machines take the soul

[Bridge]
(Distorted transmission)
Resistance is inefficient
Resistance is inefficient

[Breakdown]
Control. Control. Control.

[Chorus]
Iron directive
Command and control
Iron directive

Shutting down.
